aiReadyLines.text: Unit Seven : Games and Sports 81
In 1999 the International Olympic Committee (IOC) named Pelé the
"Athlete of the Century”. In his career he scored more than 1200 goals.
Thus he has become the top scorer of all time. In his own country, Brazil,
Pelé is a national hero. People call him "The King of Football", "The King
Pelé” or simply "The King". He is the all-time leading scorer of the
Brazilian national team. He is the only footballer to be a part of three World
Cup winning squads and the only player in the world to have three World
Cup winning medals.
E. True or false? If false, give the correct information.
In 1999 Pele was voted Football Player of the Century by 1OC.
Inthe same year, Pele was honoured as the Athlete of the century.
He is one of the top scorers in the football world with more than one
thousand goals.
Pele is an international hero in his country.
He is one of the football players with three World Cup winning medals.
